what: Folder-level manuscript records from Marquette University's own finding aid for the J.R.R. Tolkien Collection. These are MANUSCRIPTS THE ARCHIVE CAN CITE AND DOES NOT HOLD -- a fourth case beside `sources` (held), `not_held` (a publication known and not acquired) and `derived` (made here). No text and no image of any manuscript is reproduced: every row is catalogue metadata published by the repository.
repository: Marquette University, Raynor Memorial Libraries, Department of Special Collections and University Archives
notation: Marquette cites this collection two ways and BOTH are held here. `Series N, Box B, Folder F` is the main collection (Series 1 The Hobbit, 2 Farmer Giles of Ham, 3 The Lord of the Rings, 4 Mr. Bliss), cited bare as `Marquette 3/4/16`. `MSS-N/B/F` is the Nth installment of LORD OF THE RINGS ADDITIONAL MANUSCRIPTS PRESENTED BY CHRISTOPHER TOLKIEN. THEY ARE NOT THE SAME SPACE: MSS-3/1/9 is the Third Installment, not main Series 3.
